null_taxonomy.NOT_RECOVERED: Artifact absent from audited recovery; not a negative result.
null_taxonomy.UNKNOWN: Identity/value unavailable or unverified; not zero.
null_taxonomy.UNDEFINED_ZERO_CORRECT: Ratio has zero denominator; keep null with reason.
null_taxonomy.FAILED: Attempt failed; preserve as failure, not successful or scientific negative.
null_taxonomy.BUNDLE_REPORTED_UNVERIFIED: Value exists but dependent custody check fails; withhold.
null_taxonomy.OBSERVED: Recorded observation without implied independent replication or causality.
